assumptions.choice: Implemented a custom session-resetting VWAP indicator (cumulative typical_price*volume / cumulative volume, reset on date change from data.datetime.date(0))
assumptions.reason: Backtrader has no built-in intraday-resetting VWAP indicator, so it was implemented manually exactly per the formula and reset condition given in the spec.

assumptions.choice: stake parameter default = 1, used as size= argument to buy()/sell()
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly calls out 'stake/position sizing (default fixed size)' as a user-adjustable parameter but gives no numeric default; 1 matches backtrader's own default FixedSize sizer stake, overriding the canonical no-size-argument default since the spec is not silent on this parameter.

assumptions.choice: For longs, compare bar low against the stop level; for shorts, compare bar high against the stop level (rather than close)
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'close the position immediately if price touches/exceeds the stop level'; using the bar's intrabar low/high is the literal reading of a stop being 'touched' within a bar, whereas checking only the close would miss intrabar breaches.

assumptions.choice: When both stops are enabled, use max(atr_stop, pct_stop) for longs and min(atr_stop, pct_stop) for shorts
assumptions.reason: Spec defines 'tighter' as the stop closer to current price; for a long the stop sits below price so the higher of the two values is closer, and for a short the stop sits above price so the lower of the two values is closer.
